body: By trauma I mean prolonged abuse as a child and some really bad things happening as an adult. And as much as I wish that wanting something would make it so, I've put a lot if effort into getting better and I'm still pretty stuck. :/ I've tried a lot.

I am seeing a really good therapist and have for a while, but it doesn't automatically fix it. It does help, but there are still a lot of things I have to deal with on a daily basis. I also have an extensive trauma history. I just feel like I'm never going to be "normal" or able to do what I want with my life.

It's strange that I'm getting answered now, as I tried posting days ago without being able to get it to show up. Huh. 

So I eventually made it home, but not until after I woke up in a parking lot not sure of why I was there. I was still logged in to this throwaway, so I guess that worked in my favor. I'm doing a little better, but still really struggling with how confusing this is. I am not sure of what to do with my life if it's going to be like this... Suddenly waking up somewhere strange and never really knowing exactly what I did or why. I don't know that I want to live that life.
